steps.title: Welcome to OreX
steps.description: This short tutorial will cover trading, your portfolio, and where to find everything. Tap anywhere to continue, or use the Skip button to skip this tutorial.

steps.title: Your Balance
steps.description: Cash Balance is your availble free cash. Holdings Value is what your ores are worth right now. Total Value is the sum of your Cash and Holdings. Profit / Loss tracks how you are doing.

steps.title: Account Menu
steps.description: Your cash balance is always shown here. Your avatar beside it houses the account menu.

steps.title: Portfolio, Inbox & History
steps.description: These icons open your holdings, your notifications, and your trade history. You will need these frequently in your trading journey.

steps.title: Profile, Settings & Help
steps.description: Profile holds your stats, achievements, and daily bonus. Settings covers themes, security, and Advanced Mode, while Help has the FAQ and a few other useful things.

steps.title: The Market
steps.description: Every ore trades here with its current price. The arrow shows its last move, Vol is how sharply it can swing, and Base is its original base price.

steps.title: Quick Trade
steps.description: Enter a quantity and use Buy or Sell right on the card. In Standard Mode your total holding of an ore is capped at 500 units.

steps.title: Price Chart
steps.description: Each ore has a detail page with its price history. Use the range buttons, from 5 minutes up to Max, to study the trend before trading.

steps.title: Buy & Sell
steps.description: Enter a quantity and confirm to trade at the current price. You can only sell ores you already hold.

steps.title: Your Portfolio
steps.description: Everything you own appears here with your average buy price and running profit or loss. It fills in after your first purchase.

steps.title: The Leaderboard
steps.description: Players and bot traders are ranked by total value: cash plus holdings plus any short equity. See where you stand and climb the ranks.

steps.title: Advanced Mode Awaits
steps.description: Reach $100,000 net worth to become eligible, then unlock Advanced Mode for $50,000. It adds short selling, stop-loss and take-profit orders, and more, so keep it in your sights.

steps.title: You're All Set
steps.description: That's the tour. If a daily login bonus is waiting, you'll find it here on your profile. Happy trading, and remember that you can replay this tutorial any time from Help in your profile menu.

steps.title: Welcome to Advanced Mode
steps.description: You've unlocked Advanced Mode! This tutorial walks through the new tools you've acquired. Tap anywhere to continue, or Skip to leave the tour.

steps.title: Resistance & Support
steps.description: Advanced Mode tracks resistance and support, the prices an ore has tended to not fall below or not rise above. They're shown here, and drawn as dashed lines on the chart below so you can see them against the live price.

steps.title: Short Selling
steps.description: Alongside the usual Buy and Sell, a new Short tab lets you profit when an ore's price falls. To demonstrate, we've opened a one-unit sample short for you, it costs you nothing and is removed automatically when the tour ends.

steps.title: Collateral & Surcharge
steps.description: Opening a short locks up collateral, money put aside to guarantee you can pay off your investment. Position is the value you're shorting, and the Margin is the cash held against it. The Surcharge rises when an ore is already heavily shorted, so crowded shorts cost more to hold.

steps.title: Fees & Squeeze
steps.description: A small Tick Fee is charged every market tick until you close the position. This means you can't hold onto a short position forever. The Squeeze price is the price at which the short would cost you more money than you have, forcing the position to be liquidated. Thus, the closer the price gets, the more urgent it is to act.

steps.title: Managing Your Shorts
steps.description: Your open shorts live in the Shorts tab of your portfolio. Each row shows net P/L, the squeeze price, and its stop-loss / take-profit. Use Edit SL/TP to have a position close automatically at prices you choose, no watching required.

steps.title: The Finances Page
steps.description: Your balance pill is now a button. Select it any time to open the Finances page, a full breakdown of where your capital sits and how your shorts are trending.

steps.title: Capital Breakdown
steps.description: Your net worth is free cash plus long holdings plus short equity, and the bar shows how it's split. Short equity is what you'd keep if you closed your shorts now: the collateral locked for them minus the cost of buying the shares back.

steps.title: Cash Flow & Runway
steps.description: Short fees burn cash every tick. The cash-flow projection turns that burn rate into a runway, how long your free cash lasts if prices hold. Keep a buffer here to avoid a forced liquidation.

steps.title: Positions at a Glance
steps.description: Your dashboard now carries Longs and Shorts summary boxes. The Threat indicator is a quick read on liquidation risk, an at-a-glance version of the cash-flow runway from the Finances page.

steps.title: Standing Out
steps.description: Advanced players show a red name on the leaderboard. Short equity counts toward total value, so your demo short is ranked here too, for now. Bots are also actively shorting, putting money into falling ores, which can push up the collateral you may need to pay.

steps.title: You're All Set
steps.description: That's Advanced Mode. The demo short is being closed now and your account is exactly as it was, no fees, no profit or loss. Open your own shorts whenever you're ready. Additionally, the 500 unit holding limit on longs has been lifted, allowing you to make bigger investments. Remember, you can replay this tour any time from Help in your profile menu.
